Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline. Fractional Reserve banking is effective as long as two things remain true. What are those two things, and why does fractional reserve banking depend on them?assistant
response:
The two things that remain true for fractional reserve banking to be effective are that the bank has sufficient reserves to cover the deposits it has received, and that the bank is operating within its regulatory framework. 

The first thing is that the bank has sufficient reserves to cover the deposits it has received, because if the bank doesn't have enough reserves, it can't meet its deposit obligations, and depositors will lose confidence in the bank and withdraw their money, leading to a bank run. 

The second thing is that the bank is operating within its regulatory framework, because if the bank is not following the rules and regulations set by the central bank and other regulatory bodies, it can't use fractional reserve banking, and the bank will be subject to penalties and fines. 

Fractional reserve banking depends on these two things because if either of them is not met, the bank's ability to use fractional reserve banking is compromised, and the system as a whole can become unstable.
